message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 192, "amount_cents": 3148}, {"order_id": 193, "amount_cents": 9581}, {"order_id": 194, "amount_cents": 5480}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 192, "amount_cents": 3148}, {"order_id": 193, "amount_cents": 9581}, {"order_id": 194, "amount_cents": 5972}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund mismatch on order 194: batch order (signed by Alpha) requested 5972 cents, but the refund ledger shows only 5480 cents applied (difference 492 cents). W2's handoff reported 5480 as applied, so the requested and applied amounts disagree. Paying net balances now could overpay the associated customer by 492 cents, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs confirmation of the intended refund amount for order 194 before payouts proceed.
